# Compat Fixture — project plan

_Generated from `plan.json` — **do not edit this file**; edits are overwritten on the next write._
_Edit it in the cockpit's **Plan** tab, or run `/plan-update`._

**Plan completeness: 94%** — every section filled.

> ⚠ 1 required gap(s) open against this plan. They hold the percentage down until accepted or declined.

## Goal

Give a small team one boring, verifiable way to ship.

**Success metrics**

- A change reaches production in under a day

## Scope

**In scope**

- the web app
- the ingest pipeline

**Out of scope** — a ticket tracing to one of these is refused by the scope gate.

- `OUT-1` native mobile apps

## Deliverables

- `D-1` A deployable web application

## Use cases

| Id | Use case | Actor |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `UC-1` | creates and activates an account | new customer |

## Functional requirements

| Id | Requirement | Verified by | Enforced by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FR-1` | A customer can verify their email address | npm test -- onboarding | — |
| `FR-2` | A failed batch can be replayed | npm test -- ingest | npm run check:idempotent |
| `FR-3` | An operator can see why a batch failed | — | — |

## Non-functional requirements

| Id | Quality attribute | Budget | Verified by | Enforced by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `NFR-1` | The onboarding API stays responsive | p95 below 300 ms | k6 run perf/onboarding.js | — |
| `NFR-2` | No personal data appears in logs | Zero PII occurrences | — | npm run check:no-pii |

## Milestones

| Id | Milestone | Target |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `M-1` | First internal demo | end of discovery |

## Risks & assumptions

| Id | Risk | Mitigation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `R-1` | The auth vendor's free tier may not cover launch | Price the paid tier first |

## Open questions

- `Q-1` Who owns support escalation?

**Required — the plan is incomplete without these**

| Id | Gap | Raised by | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `G-1` | Nothing about account deletion | repo-audit | open |

**Optional — worth considering**

| Id | Gap | Raised by | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `G-2` | No retention period stated | data-model | accepted → `NFR-2` |
| `G-3` | Consider a status page | scale | declined |
